senses.en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food.
A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment.
Having a pale yellowish-white colour.

ex.en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.

tip: cream là kem sữa hoặc kem bôi; phô mai là cheese.

senses.en: feeling anxious about problems or something that might happen

ex.en: She looked worried when her cat failed to return.
Many parents are worried about the effects of excessive screen time on their children's sleep.

col: a worried expression｜vẻ mặt lo âu
tip: worried mô tả người lo lắng; worrying mô tả điều gây lo lắng.

senses.en: taking care to avoid danger, damage, or mistakes
giving close attention to details

ex.en: Be careful with that bowl; it belonged to Grandma.
Careful planning can help cities expand public transport while keeping construction costs under control.

col: careful planning｜lập kế hoạch kỹ lưỡng
tip: be careful with đi với vật; be careful to đi với động từ.

senses.en: not true or based on facts
made to resemble something real or natural
intended to hide someone's real feelings or intentions

ex.en: That rumour about our neighbour is completely FALSE.
Claims that all online information is reliable are FALSE, so students should learn to evaluate sources critically.

tip: false nghĩa là không đúng sự thật; fake nhấn mạnh sự giả mạo có chủ ý. Thường viết thường.

senses.en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.

ex.en: This carrot has an unusual shape, like a tiny hand.
Scientists are investigating unusual weather patterns that may be linked to rising global temperatures.

col: an unusual feature｜một đặc điểm khác thường
tip: It is unusual for sb to do nghĩa là ai đó hiếm khi làm như vậy.

senses.en: A computer program designed for a particular task.

ex.en: This app reminds me to water my plants every Sunday.
A language learning app can provide affordable practice, although it cannot fully replace interaction with a teacher.

col: download an app｜tải một ứng dụng
install an app｜cài đặt ứng dụng
language learning app｜ứng dụng học ngôn ngữ
tip: app là viết tắt của application; là danh từ đếm được, dùng an app.

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

ex.en: My lips felt dry after walking in the wind.
Clear face coverings can improve communication for people who rely on watching lips to understand speech.

col: the lip of a cup｜miệng ly
tip: Cả hai môi gọi chung là lips; lip cũng có thể chỉ vành, mép của vật chứa.

senses.en: travel for pleasure and the businesses serving people who travel

ex.en: Tourism brings many visitors to our village each summer.
Sustainable tourism can generate income for local communities while protecting the natural landscapes that attract visitors.

tip: tourism thường không đếm được; một du khách là a tourist.

senses.en: An Australian mammal with powerful hind legs; females carry pouch young.

ex.en: A young kangaroo peeked out of its mother's pouch.
Habitat loss can force kangaroo populations closer to roads, increasing the risk of collisions with vehicles.

col: a kangaroo's pouch｜túi của chuột túi
tip: Số nhiều thêm -s: kangaroos; túi nuôi con gọi là pouch.

senses.en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another
a process of personal change or development over time
to travel from one place to another

ex.en: The train journey took us through snowy mountains.
Improved rail services could shorten the daily journey to work and encourage commuters to leave their cars at home.

col: a long journey｜một chuyến đi dài
a journey of discovery｜hành trình khám phá
make a journey｜thực hiện một chuyến đi
tip: journey nhấn mạnh quãng đường đi; trip thường gồm cả chuyến đi và về.

senses.zh: túi xách tay; túi xách nữ
senses.en: A small bag for carrying personal items, typically used by women.

ex.en: She found her keys at the bottom of her handbag.
Consumers can reduce waste by choosing a durable handbag rather than replacing inexpensive accessories every season.

col: a shoulder handbag｜túi xách đeo vai
tip: Tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng purse cho túi xách nữ; trong tiếng Anh Anh, purse thường là ví đựng tiền xu.

senses.en: A small round fruit with a stone and usually red skin

senses.zh: cây anh đào; hoa anh đào
senses.en: A tree grown for its cherries or attractive blossoms

ex.en: He placed a ripe cherry on top of the cake.
Cherry trees attract visitors during spring, providing seasonal income for rural communities through tourism.

tip: Số nhiều là cherries; hạt của quả gọi là stone (Anh) hoặc pit (Mỹ).

senses.en: Weighing a lot and often difficult to lift
Greater than usual in amount, strength, or intensity
Demanding considerable effort or causing serious difficulty

ex.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me to lift.
Heavy traffic contributes to urban air pollution and increases the time people spend commuting.

col: heavy workload｜khối lượng công việc nặng nề
tip: Mưa lớn nói heavy rain, không nói big rain.

senses.en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels

ex.en: The postman left a parcel beside our front door.
In remote villages, a postman may provide an essential link between residents and public services.

col: the local postman｜người đưa thư địa phương
work as a postman｜làm nghề đưa thư
the postman's round｜tuyến đưa thư của bác đưa thư
tip: Thường dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ hay dùng mail carrier và không giới hạn giới tính.

senses.zh: trò chuyện; nói chuyện phiếm; nhắn tin
senses.en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages.
A friendly, informal conversation.

ex.en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
Community gardens allow neighbours to chat regularly, helping them build stronger relationships and reduce social isolation.

col: chat with friends｜trò chuyện với bạn bè
chat about work｜nói chuyện về công việc
have a chat｜trò chuyện một chút
tip: chat with + người, about + chủ đề; quá khứ chatted gấp đôi t.

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.

senses.zh: làm tổn thương tình cảm; gây hại
senses.en: To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.

ex.en: My ankle still hurts when I climb the stairs.
Cuts to public transport funding may hurt rural communities that depend on buses for essential journeys.

col: hurt your back｜bị thương ở lưng
hurt someone's feelings｜làm tổn thương tình cảm ai
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là hurt; bộ phận đau có thể làm chủ ngữ.

senses.en: Luckily, especially when something bad could have happened.

ex.en: Fortunately, I found my keys before the bus arrived.
Fortunately, improvements in water treatment have helped many communities reduce the spread of preventable diseases.

col: fortunately for us｜thật may cho chúng tôi
fortunately, nobody was hurt｜may mà không ai bị thương
tip: Thường đứng đầu câu, sau có dấu phẩy, để nhận xét cả sự việc là điều đáng mừng.

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

ex.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.

col: roll down a hill｜lăn xuống đồi
roll up your sleeves｜xắn tay áo lên
a roll of paper｜một cuộn giấy
tip: roll nhấn mạnh sự lăn tròn; cuộn lại thường dùng roll up.

senses.en: One of four equal parts of something.
A period of three months within a year.
An area of a town with a particular character.

ex.en: She cut the sandwich into quarters for the children.
Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.

col: a quarter of｜một phần tư của
a quarter of an hour｜mười lăm phút
tip: a quarter of an hour là mười lăm phút; “quý” trong năm cũng là quarter.

senses.en: A piece of work that needs to be done.
Give someone responsibility for a particular piece of work.

ex.en: My first task today is to water the plants.
Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.

col: complete a task｜hoàn thành nhiệm vụ
a challenging task｜một nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách
task someone with doing something｜giao cho ai làm việc gì
tip: Làm động từ dùng task sb with doing sth, nghĩa là giao nhiệm vụ cho ai.

senses.en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation

ex.en: Your advice helped me choose a comfortable bicycle.
Schools should provide practical career advice so that students can make informed decisions about their future.

col: a piece of advice｜một lời khuyên
tip: Không đếm được, không dùng an advice; động từ advise kết thúc bằng âm /z/.

senses.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

ex.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.

col: excellent service｜dịch vụ chất lượng cao
tip: Từ này đã mang nghĩa “rất tốt”, thường không dùng very để bổ nghĩa.

senses.en: to reach, or heat liquid until it reaches, bubbling temperature
to cook food in water that is bubbling from heat
a painful swollen lump in the skin containing pus

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until you can pierce them easily.
Residents should boil drinking water when flooding has damaged local supplies and increased the risk of infection.

col: bring to the boil｜đun cho sôi
boil down to｜rốt cuộc là; quy về
tip: boil là sôi hoặc đun sôi; simmer là đun liu riu.

senses.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

ex.en: This tomato sauce tastes lovely with fresh pasta.
Preparing sauce at home allows families to control the amount of salt and sugar in their meals.

col: a rich sauce｜một loại sốt đậm đà
tip: sauce là từ chung chỉ nước sốt; nước tương nói là soy sauce.

senses.en: Hair growing above the upper lip.

ex.en: My uncle carefully trims his moustache every Sunday.
In historical portraits, a carefully styled moustache often reflected contemporary ideas about fashion and social status.

col: a thick moustache｜bộ ria mép rậm
tip: moustache là râu trên môi; beard là râu ở cằm và quai hàm.

senses.en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group.
Remaining the same in form, quality, or amount.

ex.en: My school uniform is still drying by the window.
Uniform safety standards across all factories can help protect workers and improve overall working conditions.

tip: Từ bắt đầu bằng phụ âm /j/ nên nói a uniform, không dùng an.

senses.zh: chỉ dẫn; hướng dẫn thao tác
senses.en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something
An order telling someone what they must do

senses.zh: sự dạy học; sự hướng dẫn
senses.en: The activity of teaching someone a skill or subject

ex.en: The instructor gave one clear instruction: hold the rope tightly.
Students often benefit from practical instruction that connects classroom theory with everyday problems.

tip: Hướng dẫn thao tác thường dùng số nhiều instructions; nghĩa “sự dạy học” không đếm được.

senses.en: to copy data from the internet onto your device

senses.zh: việc tải xuống; tệp đã tải
senses.en: the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way

ex.en: Download the map before you leave the hotel tomorrow.
Students can download course materials at home, allowing them to study even when internet access is unavailable.

tip: Động từ nhấn âm sau, danh từ nhấn âm đầu; từ trái nghĩa là upload.

senses.en: Feeling afraid because of danger or something unexpected.

ex.en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.

col: a frightened child｜một đứa trẻ hoảng sợ
tip: frightened mô tả người cảm thấy sợ; frightening mô tả điều đáng sợ.

senses.en: the name shared by members of a family

ex.en: My surname is often difficult for strangers to pronounce.
Naming traditions vary across cultures, and a person's surname may reflect family history or regional origins.

tip: surname là họ, given name là tên; họ không nhất thiết đứng cuối.

senses.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences
something from the past that you remember
the part of a computer that stores information

ex.en: My grandmother has an excellent memory for faces.
Regular physical exercise may improve memory and help older adults maintain their independence for longer.

col: childhood memories｜kỷ niệm thời thơ ấu
tip: Nghĩa “trí nhớ” thường không đếm được; những kỷ niệm riêng lẻ dùng memories.

senses.en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.

ex.en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.

tip: pillow chủ yếu dùng khi ngủ; cushion thường là gối tựa hoặc đệm ngồi.

senses.en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.
Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically.

senses.zh: kế hoạch; khóa học; chương trình
senses.en: An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.

ex.en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.

col: run a program｜chạy một chương trình
program a computer｜lập trình cho máy tính
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh dùng program cho chương trình máy tính; kế hoạch hay chương trình truyền hình thì dùng programme.

senses.en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop
An object, mark, or gesture that communicates information
Write your name to identify yourself or show agreement

ex.en: Those dark clouds are a sign of approaching rain.
A decline in local wildlife may be a sign of wider environmental damage caused by urban expansion.

col: a sign of improvement｜dấu hiệu tiến bộ
tip: Chữ g trong sign không phát âm; a sign of đi với danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: For each unit of something.

ex.en: The swimming pool costs five pounds per visit.
Reducing energy consumption per household is an important step towards lowering a country's carbon emissions.

tip: Sau per thường là danh từ số ít không có mạo từ, như per day.

senses.en: the science of substances and how they react

senses.zh: thành phần và biến đổi hóa học
senses.en: the chemical properties and processes of a substance

senses.zh: sự ăn ý; sự hòa hợp
senses.en: a natural connection or attraction between people

ex.en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.

tip: Tên môn học thường không đếm được: study chemistry, không thêm a.

senses.en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended
fall or bend downwards loosely

ex.en: Please hang your wet coat beside the front door.
Museums often hang paintings at different heights to make their collections accessible to visitors of all ages.

col: hang on a wall｜treo trên tường
hang out the washing｜phơi quần áo
tip: Với nghĩa “treo”, quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ là hung; với nghĩa “treo cổ” thì dùng hanged.

senses.en: more than usual, or more than other people or things

ex.en: I enjoy cooking, especially when friends come for dinner.
Reliable public transport is especially important for residents who cannot afford to own a car.

tip: especially nhấn mạnh “nhất là”; specially thường nghĩa là “dành riêng”.

senses.en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.

col: unspoilt countryside｜vùng quê còn nguyên sơ
protect the countryside｜bảo vệ môi trường nông thôn
tip: Thường không đếm được, hay nói the countryside, không nói a countryside.

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.

senses.zh: tình trạng tốt; sự hưng thịnh
senses.en: How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.

col: in good health｜có sức khỏe tốt
tip: Thường không đếm được; nói về sức khỏe tốt dùng in good health.

senses.zh: di động; có thể di chuyển
senses.en: able to move or be moved easily between places

senses.zh: thuộc di động; thuộc viễn thông di động
senses.en: relating to phones or services used while away from home
a telephone you can carry and use almost anywhere

ex.en: The mobile library visits our village every Friday morning.
Mobile clinics can improve access to basic healthcare for people living in remote rural communities.

col: mobile workforce｜lực lượng lao động di chuyển
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh hay nói a mobile để chỉ điện thoại di động; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường nói a cell phone.

senses.en: The usually flat, green parts of plants.
Goes away from somewhere, or lets something remain.

ex.en: Golden leaves covered the path outside our house.
Fallen leaves provide habitats for small organisms and return valuable nutrients to the soil as they decompose.

tip: Vừa là số nhiều của leaf, vừa là ngôi thứ ba số ít của leave.

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable, used informally.
Very or extremely, used informally before adjectives or adverbs.

ex.en: We had a super afternoon playing games in the garden.
Although users may describe an app as super helpful, researchers need objective evidence to assess its educational value.

col: a super idea｜một ý tưởng tuyệt vời
tip: Mang sắc thái khẩu ngữ mạnh; trong văn viết trang trọng nên dùng excellent hoặc very.

senses.en: a choice made after considering different possibilities

ex.en: Moving closer to work was a good decision.
Governments should base every major transport decision on reliable evidence and consultation with the communities affected.

col: make a decision｜đưa ra quyết định
reach a decision｜đạt được quyết định
informed decision｜quyết định có cân nhắc kỹ
tip: Đưa ra quyết định dùng make a decision, không dùng do.

senses.en: warmth or a high temperature
to make or become warmer
a race that decides who enters the next round

ex.en: We rested under a tree to escape the heat.
Cities can reduce extreme heat by planting trees and replacing dark surfaces with materials that reflect sunlight.

col: heat up food｜hâm nóng thức ăn
tip: heat là danh từ chỉ sức nóng; hot là tính từ nghĩa là nóng.

senses.en: The time around the middle of the day when people eat.

ex.en: At lunchtime, we sat outside and shared some sandwiches.
Providing quiet spaces at lunchtime may help employees relax and return to work with greater focus.

col: a lunchtime walk｜đi dạo giờ ăn trưa
tip: Muốn nói “vào giờ ăn trưa” thường dùng at lunchtime.

senses.zh: người chiến thắng; người thắng cuộc
senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition

senses.zh: người hoặc vật thành công; người hưởng lợi
senses.en: someone or something successful or benefiting from a situation

ex.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.

col: the overall winner｜người thắng chung cuộc
a clear winner｜người thắng rõ ràng
tip: winner chỉ người chiến thắng; winning có thể làm tính từ bổ nghĩa cho đội.

senses.en: The study of quantities, shapes, patterns, and their relationships.

ex.en: She enjoys mathematics, especially solving puzzles about shapes.
A strong foundation in mathematics enables students to interpret data and evaluate claims in everyday life.

tip: Dù kết thúc bằng s, tên môn học dùng với động từ số ít; tiếng Anh Anh viết tắt là maths.

senses.zh: thuộc Ai Cập; người Ai Cập
senses.en: relating to Egypt, its people, or its culture
a person from Egypt

ex.en: We admired Egyptian pottery at the museum yesterday.
Ancient Egyptian irrigation systems demonstrate how communities adapted farming practices to seasonal changes in river levels.

col: ancient Egyptian civilisation｜nền văn minh Ai Cập cổ đại
tip: Phải viết hoa chữ cái đầu; nhiều người Ai Cập dùng Egyptians.

senses.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.
To feel afraid or worried about someone or something.

ex.en: She held my hand because of her fear of heights.
Fear of failure may prevent students from asking questions, especially in highly competitive learning environments.

col: fear of heights｜chứng sợ độ cao
overcome a fear｜vượt qua nỗi sợ
fear for someone's safety｜lo cho sự an toàn của ai
for fear of｜vì sợ; e rằng
tip: fear sth là sợ điều gì; fear for sb là lo lắng cho ai.

senses.en: To like or choose something more than another option.

ex.en: I prefer fresh fruit to cake after dinner.
Some employees prefer working from home because it offers greater flexibility and eliminates daily commuting.

col: prefer A to B｜thích A hơn B
prefer to do｜thích làm gì hơn
tip: Dùng prefer A to B; quá khứ preferred gấp đôi r.

senses.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.

col: as cool as a cucumber｜rất bình tĩnh
tip: Thường đếm được: a cucumber; khi chỉ nguyên liệu cũng có thể không đếm được.

senses.en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.

ex.en: The café offers free wifi near the window seats.
Providing reliable public wifi can help residents access essential services and participate in online learning.

tip: Cách viết chuẩn thường là Wi-Fi; thường không đếm được, không thêm a.

senses.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.
A particularly useful or attractive feature of something.

ex.en: We stopped to admire the beauty of the lake.
Protecting the natural beauty of coastal areas can support tourism while preserving valuable habitats for wildlife.

col: the beauty of something｜điểm hay của điều gì
tip: Nghĩa “vẻ đẹp” thường không đếm được; the beauty of cũng có thể chỉ điểm hay.

senses.en: located a short distance away
at or to a place a short distance away

ex.en: We bought fresh bread from a nearby bakery.
Access to nearby parks encourages urban residents to exercise regularly and spend more time outdoors.

col: a nearby park｜một công viên gần đó
tip: nearby không làm giới từ: nói near the school, không nói nearby the school.

senses.en: the money needed to buy or do something
to require a particular amount of money

senses.zh: cái giá phải trả; tổn thất
senses.en: something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.

col: the cost of living｜chi phí sinh hoạt
cover the cost｜chi trả chi phí
cost a fortune｜tốn một khoản lớn
tip: Khi nghĩa là “tốn”, quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là cost.

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

ex.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.

col: put up a tent｜dựng lều lên
tip: “Dựng lều” dùng pitch hoặc put up a tent.

senses.zh: của ai; mà ... của người đó
senses.en: used before a noun to ask or show who owns something
used to ask who something belongs to

ex.en: Whose umbrella is dripping water all over the floor?
Children whose parents read regularly at home may develop a stronger interest in books.

tip: whose chỉ sở hữu; who’s là dạng viết tắt của who is hoặc who has.

senses.zh: thịt xông khói; ba chỉ muối
senses.en: salted or smoked pork, usually served in thin slices

ex.en: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast on Sunday.
Reducing consumption of processed meat, including bacon, is often recommended as part of a healthier diet.

col: a slice of bacon｜một lát thịt xông khói
bacon and eggs｜thịt xông khói với trứng
tip: Thường không đếm được; “một lát” dùng a slice of bacon.

senses.en: In a way that shows pleasure or enjoyment.
Willingly and without objection.
With a fortunate or pleasing result.

ex.en: The children chatted happily while making sandwiches together.
Many residents would happily use public transport if services were more reliable and affordable.

col: happily married｜có hôn nhân hạnh phúc
tip: Happily đứng đầu câu có thể nghĩa là “may mắn thay”, không chỉ là vui vẻ.

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

ex.en: A helmet helps protect your brain if you fall.
Adequate sleep supports healthy brain function and helps learners remember information more effectively.

tip: Khi nói về trí tuệ thường dùng số nhiều brains; chỉ cơ quan thì dùng brain.

senses.en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.

col: crowded streets｜những con phố đông đúc
tip: be crowded with nghĩa là “chật ních”.

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.

col: promise to do something｜hứa làm điều gì
tip: Dùng promise to do, không dùng promise doing.

senses.en: Feeling sad or lacking happiness
Not satisfied with someone or something

ex.en: He looked unhappy when the picnic was cancelled.
Residents are unhappy with the proposed road expansion because it would remove valuable green space.

col: unhappy with the service｜không hài lòng với dịch vụ
an unhappy childhood｜một tuổi thơ không vui
tip: unhappy with thường nghĩa là “không hài lòng với”.

senses.en: a subject, situation or problem needing thought or attention
to be important or make a difference
physical substance that occupies space and has mass

ex.en: We can discuss this matter after lunch today.
The quality of teaching matters more than expensive equipment when schools aim to improve student achievement.

col: a serious matter｜một vấn đề nghiêm trọng
a matter of time｜vấn đề thời gian
tip: Khi chỉ sự việc thường đếm được; khi chỉ vật chất thì không đếm được; làm động từ nghĩa là quan trọng.

senses.en: light and warmth coming from the sun

senses.zh: niềm vui; người hay điều mang lại niềm vui
senses.en: happiness, or someone or something that brings happiness

ex.en: We ate our breakfast outside in the warm sunshine.
Access to parks and sunshine can improve residents' wellbeing, especially in densely populated urban areas.

col: a ray of sunshine｜người mang lại niềm vui
tip: sunshine thường không đếm được; ngày nắng có thể nói a sunny day.

senses.en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems.

senses.zh: thiết kế chế tạo; dàn xếp
senses.en: To design something technical or skilfully arrange an outcome.

ex.en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.

col: engineer a solution｜tạo ra một giải pháp khéo léo
tip: engineer cũng có thể là động từ, nghĩa là thiết kế hoặc khéo léo dàn xếp để đạt kết quả.

senses.en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock

ex.en: We stopped for a picnic beside the lake at midday.
Outdoor workers should avoid direct sunlight around midday to reduce the risk of heat exhaustion.

tip: Chỉ thời điểm dùng at; cũng có thể đứng trước danh từ, như midday sun.

senses.en: a shelf used for storing books

ex.en: She placed her favourite novel on the wooden bookshelf.
A well-stocked bookshelf in every classroom can encourage children to explore subjects beyond the school curriculum.

col: a well-stocked bookshelf｜giá sách nhiều sách
tip: Số nhiều là bookshelves, chú ý đổi f thành ves.

senses.en: Pleasant to look at
Having qualities that make people interested in choosing something

ex.en: The garden looks especially attractive when the roses bloom.
Flexible working hours make teaching a more attractive career option for some university graduates.

col: an attractive appearance｜ngoại hình ưa nhìn
an attractive salary｜mức lương hấp dẫn
an attractive option｜một lựa chọn hấp dẫn
attractive to visitors｜hấp dẫn du khách
tip: Có thể tả ngoại hình ưa nhìn, cũng có thể tả phương án hoặc mức lương hấp dẫn.

senses.en: An opinion or belief about something.
What you can see from a particular place.
To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.

ex.en: My view is that we should leave earlier.
Many residents view investment in public transport as an effective way to reduce urban pollution.

col: express a view｜bày tỏ quan điểm
view something as｜coi việc gì là
tip: Quan điểm về dùng view on; coi việc gì là dùng view…as….

senses.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.
Used to introduce the last point or action.

ex.en: After searching all morning, I finally found my keys.
Finally, governments should invest in reliable public transport to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.

col: finally arrive｜cuối cùng cũng đến nơi
finally succeed｜cuối cùng cũng thành công
finally agree｜cuối cùng cũng đồng ý
tip: Khi nghĩa là “cuối cùng cũng”, finally thường đứng trước động từ thường; khi nêu ý cuối cùng thường đứng đầu câu.

senses.en: A toy shaped like a person.

ex.en: My little cousin tucked her doll into a tiny bed.
Playing with dolls can help young children develop communication skills and explore different social roles.

tip: Thường chỉ đồ chơi hình người; dùng để gọi phụ nữ có thể bị coi là thiếu tôn trọng.

senses.en: a reason given to explain or defend a fault
forgive someone for a mistake or impolite behaviour

senses.zh: cho miễn; cho phép rời đi
senses.en: allow someone to avoid a duty or leave

ex.en: He made an excuse for arriving late to dinner.
Limited funding should not become an excuse for neglecting essential maintenance in schools and public hospitals.

col: excuse me｜xin lỗi; làm ơn cho qua
excuse someone from｜cho ai miễn khỏi
tip: Danh từ kết thúc bằng âm /s/, động từ kết thúc bằng /z/; excuse me dùng để ngắt lời lịch sự.

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.

tip: Khi tả chất lỏng, thick nghĩa là đặc sánh, không nhất thiết là vị đậm.

senses.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

ex.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.

tip: Nói play chess, không thêm mạo từ the.

senses.en: A kilogram, a unit used to measure mass.

ex.en: Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes, please?
Comparing food prices per kilo can help households manage their budgets and make more economical purchasing decisions.

col: a kilo of rice｜một cân gạo
tip: kilo thường là cách nói tắt của kilogram, không chỉ ki-lô-mét.

senses.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

ex.en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
Early access to medical care can prevent minor illnesses from developing into serious health problems.

col: recover from an illness｜hồi phục sau bệnh
tip: Nói chung về việc bị ốm thì không đếm được; khi chỉ một bệnh cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: Pain felt in the head.

senses.zh: vấn đề nan giải; điều đau đầu
senses.en: A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.

ex.en: I have a headache, so I need some quiet.
Ageing transport infrastructure has become a major headache for local authorities facing increasingly limited budgets.

col: a severe headache｜cơn đau đầu dữ dội
a major headache｜một vấn đề lớn nan giải
tip: Một lần đau đầu dùng a headache, thường nói have a headache.

senses.en: A large container for rubbish, usually kept outside.

ex.en: Please put that rubbish in the dustbin outside.
Providing a separate dustbin for food waste can help households reduce the amount of rubbish sent to landfill.

col: put rubbish in the dustbin｜bỏ rác vào thùng rác
tip: Là từ của tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng garbage can hoặc trash can.

senses.en: To become visible or come into view.
To seem to be a certain way.
To take part in a performance or attend court formally.

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.

tip: Khi nghĩa là “có vẻ” thì đi với tính từ hoặc to do; không đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ.

senses.en: not in or to any place

ex.en: There was nowhere to sit on the crowded train.
Without affordable housing, some low-income families have nowhere to live despite having regular paid employment.

col: in the middle of nowhere｜ở nơi hẻo lánh
tip: Bản thân từ này đã mang nghĩa phủ định: I have nowhere to go.

senses.en: a flying insect that collects pollen; some kinds make honey

ex.en: A bee landed gently on the yellow flower.
Protecting bees is essential for agriculture because these insects pollinate many crops that humans depend on.

col: a swarm of bees｜một đàn ong
tip: bee đồng âm với be; đàn ong có thể nói a swarm of bees.

senses.en: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire.
Equipment for cooking food over a fire outdoors.
To cook food on a grill over a fire.

ex.en: We invited our neighbours to a barbecue in the garden.
Designated barbecue areas allow visitors to cook outdoors while reducing the risk of fires in public parks.

col: have a barbecue｜tổ chức tiệc nướng
tip: Có thể chỉ buổi tiệc nướng hay bếp nướng, cũng có thể làm động từ; thường viết tắt là BBQ.

senses.en: a request for someone to attend or join something

ex.en: We received an invitation to our neighbour's garden party.
An invitation to participate in local planning can encourage residents to take greater responsibility for their neighbourhood.

col: decline an invitation｜từ chối lời mời
an invitation to dinner｜lời mời ăn tối
by invitation only｜chỉ dành cho khách mời
tip: Mời tham gia sự kiện dùng invitation to; mời làm việc gì dùng to do.

senses.en: Someone who arranges meetings and handles office communication.

senses.zh: thư ký của hội; ủy viên
senses.en: An official managing an organisation's records and routine business.
A senior government official responsible for a particular department.

ex.en: The secretary arranged a meeting for tomorrow afternoon.
A school secretary often provides essential support by coordinating appointments and communicating with parents throughout the day.

col: club secretary｜thư ký câu lạc bộ
tip: Có thể chỉ thư ký văn phòng, cũng có thể chỉ một số bộ trưởng trong chính phủ.

senses.en: Moving to a position on a surface.

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the sofa beside me.
Moving freight onto trains could reduce road congestion and lower emissions from the transport sector.

tip: onto nhấn mạnh sự di chuyển lên bề mặt; on thường chỉ vị trí đã ở trên.

senses.zh: giải thưởng; phần thưởng; tiền thưởng
senses.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something
to value something very highly

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.

col: highly prized｜được đánh giá rất cao
tip: prize cũng có thể là động từ, nghĩa là quý trọng; hay gặp be highly prized.

senses.en: corn kernels heated until they burst into light, fluffy pieces

ex.en: We shared a bowl of popcorn during the film.
Cinemas often earn additional revenue by selling snacks such as popcorn alongside tickets for film screenings.

col: a bowl of popcorn｜một bát bỏng ngô
tip: Thường là danh từ không đếm được; “một hạt” có thể nói a piece of popcorn.

senses.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates
To move or travel very fast
To drive faster than the legal limit

ex.en: The train picked up speed as we left town.
Reducing vehicle speeds near schools can significantly improve road safety for children walking or cycling to class.

col: at high speed｜với tốc độ cao
a speed limit｜giới hạn tốc độ
tip: speed up nghĩa là tăng tốc; speed làm động từ cũng có thể là chạy quá tốc độ.

senses.en: a device used for cooking food or heating a room

ex.en: A pot of soup is bubbling on the stove.
Replacing traditional indoor stoves with cleaner models can reduce household air pollution and improve respiratory health.

tip: stove dùng để nấu ăn hoặc sưởi ấm; oven chỉ lò nướng.

senses.en: A tropical fruit with sweet orange flesh and a large stone

ex.en: This mango is sweet enough to eat without sugar.
Improved storage facilities can help mango farmers reduce food waste and earn more reliable incomes.

tip: Số nhiều viết mangoes hoặc mangos đều đúng.

senses.en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow
an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy

ex.en: He swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
Although a pill may relieve symptoms, lasting improvements in health often require changes to daily habits.

col: take a pill｜uống một viên thuốc
swallow a pill｜nuốt một viên thuốc
tip: take a pill là uống thuốc; the pill thường chỉ riêng thuốc tránh thai.

senses.en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens
a person who lives in a particular area
affecting only a limited part of something

ex.en: We buy fresh bread from our local bakery every morning.
Supporting local businesses can strengthen community ties and keep more money circulating within the regional economy.

tip: Danh từ số nhiều locals chỉ người địa phương; locally là trạng từ.

senses.en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight.
To prevent others from knowing or noticing something.
The skin of a large animal, often used for leather.

ex.en: We hid the birthday present under the bed.
Companies should not hide information about environmental risks associated with their products or manufacturing processes.

col: hide from view｜giấu khỏi tầm nhìn
hide the truth｜che giấu sự thật
hide your feelings｜che giấu cảm xúc
tip: Quá khứ hid, quá khứ phân từ hidden; hide from nghĩa là trốn tránh.

senses.en: not sleeping
to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

ex.en: I was still awake when the rain finally stopped.
Students who stay awake late at night may struggle to concentrate during lessons the following morning.

tip: Tính từ thường làm vị ngữ; động từ chia là awoke, awoken.

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.

col: make a noise｜gây ra tiếng động
tip: Nói chung về tiếng ồn thì không đếm được; một tiếng động cụ thể có thể dùng a noise.

senses.zh: gậy; cành cây; cây gậy chống
senses.en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes.
To attach something, or become attached, using a sticky substance.
To push a pointed object into something.

ex.en: The dog brought a stick back to me.
Students can stick pictures onto a shared poster to present their research on local wildlife.

col: stick to a plan｜bám sát kế hoạch
stick a picture on｜dán một bức ảnh lên
tip: Là động từ, quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ là stuck; stick to nghĩa là kiên trì làm theo.

senses.en: relating to Ireland, its people, or their culture
a Celtic language traditionally spoken in Ireland
the people of Ireland, referred to collectively

ex.en: An Irish musician played the fiddle at our festival.
Traditional Irish music can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors to rural communities across the country.

tip: the Irish chỉ người Ireland nói chung; một người dùng an Irish person.

senses.en: happening often or found in many places
shared by two or more people or groups

ex.en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
Governments should address the common challenges that prevent rural communities from accessing affordable healthcare.

col: a common problem｜một vấn đề phổ biến
have something in common｜có điểm chung
tip: common nghĩa là phổ biến hoặc chung; ordinary nhấn mạnh sự bình thường, không đặc biệt.
